stem: Which statement explains why delegates from smaller states opposed parts of the Virginia Plan?

options.label: A
options.text: There were concerns that free states would have too much power.

options.label: B
options.text: There were concerns that the federal government would become too strong.

options.label: C
options.text: There were concerns that the legislature would be able to control the judicial branch.

options.label: D
options.text: There were concerns that some states would be able to easily control the government.
